analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined from 55.9 five days ago to 49.5 currently, continuing sideways movement in the neutral zone. MACD histogram also worsened from -1.1144 to -1.1794, failing to generate a trend reversal signal. Volume ratio at 0.86 of the 5-day average indicates sideways movement without strong volume. Price is navigating between SMA20 ($262.20) and the swing resistance at $258.60, seeking direction.
